findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_map_comments, list_threads, list_workspace_comments, describe_open_campaign, bind_session, target_list · Private data: commit_version, list_scenario_versions, restore_version, confirm_connection, provision_customer, list_map_themes, set_ballot_order, resolve_map_comment, revoke_share, get_usage, answer_assumption · Public sink: set_performance, compute_vote_goal, set_turnout, set_swings, react_map_comment, list_siblings, share_simulation, revoke_share, set_primary_candidates, exit_primary_candidate, set_primary_county_shares, set_primary_precinct_shares, roll_up_primary, primary_batch_edit, set_race_scope, target_list · Destructive: delete_race, provision_customer, set_candidates, remove_candidate, reset_overrides, remove_annotation, clear_annotations, remove_map_comment, delete_simulation, delete_report, clear_precinct_override, exposure, exit_primary_candidate, clear_primary_shares, clear_race_scope.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_map_comments, list_threads, list_workspace_comments, describe_open_campaign, bind_session, target_list · Private data: commit_version, list_scenario_versions, restore_version, confirm_connection, provision_customer, list_map_themes, set_ballot_order, resolve_map_comment, revoke_share, get_usage, answer_assumption · Public sink: set_performance, compute_vote_goal, set_turnout, set_swings, react_map_comment, list_siblings, share_simulation, revoke_share, set_primary_candidates, exit_primary_candidate, set_primary_county_shares, set_primary_precinct_shares, roll_up_primary, primary_batch_edit, set_race_scope, target_list · Destructive: delete_race, provision_customer, set_candidates, remove_candidate, reset_overrides, remove_annotation, clear_annotations, remove_map_comment, delete_simulation, delete_report, clear_precinct_override, exposure, exit_primary_candidate, clear_primary_shares, clear_race_scope

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
